source.label: 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A), Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management (printed p. 75)
source.quote: The following table sets forth information with respect to the beneficial ownership of our common stock as of March 31, 2025 for: ... each person who is known to be the beneficial owner of more than 5% of shares of our outstanding common stock; ... each of our current named executive officers and directors; and ... all of our executive officers and directors as a group. ... The beneficial ownership of our voting securities is based on 39,991,026 shares of our common stock issued and outstanding as of March 31, 2025.

structure.note: One class of common stock with one vote per share. The 2025 proxy lists no holder of more than 5%. Virgin Investments Limited (VIL), whose board nominees the proxy calls the 'VG designees', keeps contractual rights under a 2019 Stockholders' Agreement: it may designate two directors (currently Craig Kreeger and Luigi Brambilla) while it beneficially owns at least 1,434,880 shares, and while it can designate two directors its consent is needed for certain corporate actions. The proxy does not state how many shares VIL holds.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001706946-25-000038), reported in thousands; stock comp matches SEC XBRL ($29.75 million, shown as 0.03 billion). Ownership is from the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 15, 2025, accession 0001706946-25-000063). Share counts reflect the 1-for-20 reverse stock split of June 2024. LEADER: Richard Branson, whom the 10-K calls 'our Founder', is not a director or officer and is not listed in the ownership table, which shows no 5% holder at all. VIRGIN GROUP: the brief asked for Virgin Group's holding in the 2025 proxy. None is disclosed. The proxy says only that VIL keeps two board designees 'for as long as VIL beneficially owns 1,434,880 or more shares' (25% of what Vieco USA held after the 2019 business combination, with shares distributed to a third party still counted as VIL's), and that Messrs. Kreeger and Brambilla currently serve as the VG designees. That is a threshold, not a reported holding, so no family/Virgin figure is recorded and no percentage is derived from it. VIL's exact stake would need its own Schedule 13D/A filings, which were not read. largestHolders is empty because the proxy names no 5% holder. GEOGRAPHY: null. The 10-K reports one operating segment and gives no revenue by geography; total 2024 revenue was $7.0 million. DIVIDENDS AND BUYBACKS: the 2024 financing section has no dividend or repurchase line, so both are 0; the 10-K also says 'We do not intend to pay cash dividends for the foreseeable future.' PLAN: no employee stock purchase plan is described in the documents read.
